approvedInsertions.at: Sleep training methods at a glance
approvedInsertions.heading: UK and AU leaflets may say **controlled crying** or **controlled comforting**. Treat those as names for a graduated-interval plan (this table’s extinction / Ferber family), not as a new row that needs its own URL. **Camping out** / “transition settling” stays with the chair method on [gentle sleep training](/gentle-sleep-training). Cue-led **responsive settling** has its own page and is not a third extinction method.
## “Eat, play, sleep” — a flexible pattern, not a law

approvedInsertions.at: A routine is not a whole sleep plan
approvedInsertions.heading: A popular daytime slogan, **eat–play–sleep** (or feed–play–sleep), is the same idea in a different order of the day: a flexible, cue-led pattern, not a rigid law, and not a newborn schedule. The longer caveat lives on [newborn sleep schedule](/newborn-sleep-schedule).
